re Charles GROEHL: 7 Rue Barrault, Paris 13.

On 29th April, M/S received a letter from Carl OTTEN as follows:-

"I thought you were coming today, as I wanted to discuss with you a certain matter which is in the closest connection with our work. The fact is that I expect the visit of a friend who has made certain researches in this sphere. He has money and a visa, but is unwilling to come without an invitation. Will you be kind enough to send him such an invitation?

His address is: Monsieur Charles Groehl.
7 rue Barrault,
Paris 13.

I should be especially grateful if you would send this invitation by air mail, so that our friend receives it on Saturday. He wants to come this weekend, and is only waiting for the invitation. Write it in English, something like this:

'Dear friend,
I should be very pleased if you could come for the weekend. I can put you up, and then we can discuss our literary plans in peace and quiet.
With greetings etc.'

I should be extremely grateful if you could attend to this at once. I will repay all expenses you may incur. The main thing is that it deals with the two days visit of an extremely important man. Burn this letter. See you tomorrow evening.
Karl Otten."

Since reporting this to us M/S has seen OTTEN and has learned a little more about GROEHL. He is a German refugee living in Paris and he is a specialist in electrical matters. He is very intimate with the Saar district and he appears to have obtained some information regarding Germany's electrical preparations on the Saar frontier. It seems that electricity is used very largely in the frontier defences. GROEHL is prepared to give his information to OTTEN for the book on Germany's war preparations. OTTEN's group is very anxious for GROEHL to meet M/S so we may be able to obtain further information. The group has recently received information that Germany intends to have 24,000 war aircraft by the autumn.

5.3.38.
